card.name: The word all after a verb
card.fires_on: The word "all" right after a verb, where it begins an object or phrase such as "all the", "all that", "all over" or "all the way". It appears in general web prose.

modes.label: All as object
modes.description: "all" follows a verb and introduces what was got, eaten, done or listed.
modes.example: they had eaten<< all>> that, they had no longer meat to

modes.label: All in set phrases
modes.description: "all" follows a verb inside a fixed phrase like "all the way", "all over" or "all too well".
modes.example: To make sure your eye goes<< all>> the way back there.

card.plain: It marks the little word "all" when it comes straight after a verb in ordinary sentences.
